about: Steam games with EasyAntiCheat that run offline without it when their exe is started directly with steam_appid.txt (the Steam app id) beside it: the only games SCSKiller offers an offline recording session for. exe: the file the game's Steam id is discovered with. Elden Ring Nightreign has an offline mode but no source confirms this launch, so it isn't listed.
